title: Amend the charter, or accept 130 stories as 1.0
description:

title: Give TestCtx a seed and a fast tick before the journey harness grows
description:
Two gaps found while reviewing the walking-skeleton harness plan.

1. NO SEED. SimulationOptions exposes only terrain_size and save_replay. JOURNEY-0001's final observable claims 'identical seed and inputs yield identical ledger figures', but there is no seed field - today that can only mean 'identical construction'. Either add a seed or reword the observable.

2. TICK COST. TestCtx::tick() does a full bincode encode + decode + per-key hashes() comparison EVERY tick. That is exactly the determinism guarantee we want, but it will dominate runtime on a multi-hundred-tick journey. Add a tick_fast() without the round-trip and keep the checked tick for boundaries.

Not blocking ITER-0000, which is short. Becomes painful as journeys lengthen.
close_reason: commit 2fcfd94: SimulationOptions gained seed:u64 threaded to RandProvider in the WorldCommand::Init handler (world_command.rs:332), replacing the hardwired private const RNG_SEED=123. Fast tick added: check_determinism() split out of tick(), advance_ticks(n) checks every 25th tick and always the last. Verified cargo test -p simulation -- --test-threads=1 -> 22 passed.

title: STORY-0107: inspection panel showing requested vs consumed
description:
ITER-0000, not started. AC-1: selecting a building shows, for at least one input, both the requested/received quantity and the recipe's true per-cycle consumption (or a derived surplus) in the same panel. AC-2: two identical buildings, one honest and one inflated, and the inflated one visibly accumulates surplus over cycles.

This is the payoff of the whole iteration - hoarding must be a DISCOVERABLE gameplay fact, not a backend number. Lives in native_app/.

CEILING already accepted in the roadmap: TestCtx is pub(crate) under cfg(test) and cannot drive the UI, so this AC is proven as sim-observable PLUS an eyeballed panel, not full e2e. Assert the accessor the panel binds to is public API on the simulation crate, and record the panel render as a manual observation.

title: simulation test binary segfaults under parallel test threads
description:
GATE on evidence reliability. PRE-EXISTING - reproduced on an unmodified tree (1 in 5 runs), NOT introduced by ITER-0000.

SYMPTOM: 'cargo test -p simulation' with default parallel threads segfaults intermittently (SIGSEGV, no Rust backtrace - a raw crash, not a panic). Reproduces ~1-in-3 to 1-in-5.

ROOT CAUSE: crate::init::init() (simulation/src/init.rs:33) pushes into 'static mut' INIT_FUNCS / GSYSTEMS / SAVELOAD_FUNCS with no synchronization. Every TestCtx::new() called it unconditionally, so concurrent test threads race on those pushes. rustc already warns here: 'creating a mutable reference to mutable static ... undefined behavior'.

PARTIAL FIX ALREADY IN TREE: TestCtx::new() now guards the init::init() call with std::sync::Once (simulation/src/tests/mod.rs). This REDUCES but does NOT eliminate the crash - some other unsynchronized global path is also involved and was not chased, to respect the do-not-touch-adjacent-code rule.

WORKAROUND until fixed: run 'cargo test -p simulation -- --test-threads=1'. All ITER-0000 verification used it.

WHY P1: the iterative-development spine treats sentinel scenario runs as evidence. A suite that segfaults 1-in-5 produces a confidently wrong signal - a green run proves little and a red run gets blamed on the wrong change. Fix before the sentinel corpus grows.

TRAP: do not 'fix' this by making the tests single-threaded in CI config and calling it done. That hides the UB rather than removing it; the static mut pattern is the defect.

title: Finish STORY-0149 AC-4: real truck drives dispatch, not a tick countdown
description:
GATE on ITER-0000 meaning anything. economy/market.rs drives delivery off DISPATCH_TRAVEL_TICKS=3, a blind countdown - no vehicle, no road, no distance. 'Nothing teleports' holds as bookkeeping, not physics.

TRAP that has now eaten two agents: trucks are NOT shaped like trains. TrainEnt has no parking, so freight_station.rs can set train.it directly. VehicleEnt carries VehicleState{Parked|Driving|Panicking|RoadToPark} and transportation/road.rs:55-58 moves a vehicle ONLY when Driving/Panicking AND holding a Transporter collider. Setting .it on a parked truck is a NO-OP.

unpark() is transportation/vehicle.rs:107 and needs &mut Simulation, which Market::advance_dispatches (a World+Resources system) lacks. Use the deferred command-buffer pattern from map_dynamic/router.rs:217. There is NO park() counterpart.

Full brief with the next-agent map: docs/superpowers/iterations/brief-truck.md
Prior art: souls/freight_station.rs is the ONLY correct example of driving a dispatched delivery.
Registration was fixed in 35ce342 (the commented block had two bugs: DispatchID::Truck vs SmallTruck, .trans.position vs .trans.pos).
